name: party-coverage-v54
sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS party_coverage_bank_resolution_events (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,bank_transaction_id INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES bank_transactions(id),reconciliation_id TEXT NOT NULL,journal_entry_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES journal_entries(id),transaction_hash TEXT NOT NULL,journal_entry_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(journal_entry_hash)=64),resolution_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(resolution_type IN ('linked','no_external')),party_id TEXT,party_role TEXT,evidence_reference TEXT NOT NULL,rationale TEXT NOT NULL,plan_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(plan_hash)=64),actor TEXT NOT NULL,principal TEXT NOT NULL,created_at TEXT NOT NULL,CHECK((resolution_type='linked' AND party_id IS NOT NULL AND party_role IS NOT NULL) OR (resolution_type='no_external' AND party_id IS NULL AND party_role IS NULL))); CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS party_coverage_bank_resolution_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON party_coverage_bank_resolution_events BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'party coverage bank resolutions are append-only'); END; CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS party_coverage_bank_resolution_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON party_coverage_bank_resolution_events BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'party coverage bank resolutions are append-only'); END; CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS party_coverage_batch_events (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,plan_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(plan_hash)=64),population_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(population_hash)=64),plan_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(plan_json)),result_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(result_json)),idempotency_key_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(idempotency_key_hash)=64),actor TEXT NOT NULL,principal TEXT NOT NULL,created_at TEXT NOT NULL,UNIQUE(principal,idempotency_key_hash)); CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS party_coverage_batch_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON party_coverage_batch_events BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'party coverage batch events are append-only'); END; CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS party_coverage_batch_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON party_coverage_batch_events BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'party coverage batch events are append-only'); END;
